description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
When Woodfall Primus enters, it triggers, destroying a noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
